title: On blockwise and reference panel-based estimators for genetic data prediction in high dimensions
version_notes: The DOI-named cached file has an arXiv:2203.12003v1 margin stamp dated 22 March 2022 and a title-page date of 13 June 2025. Both dates are preserved; the cause of the difference is not established.

The 60-page PDF contains main text and references on pages 1–27, followed by attached Supplementary Material beginning on page 28. Only its title heading was inspected; supplementary mathematics is excluded.
